Market today: The market mood is cautious, driven by high Treasury yields and upcoming Fed data. This directly impacts your growth-heavy tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable.

Your holdings: SOXL (-27.16%) and SPAL (-24.89%) are deep in the red. These are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay over time and drops are amplified, especially on margin. They need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yield movements and any news from the upcoming AI risk hearings. These will set the tone for your tech and chip positions.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged losing positions; market macro and AI sentiment are key drivers for your book.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are decaying and deeply negative; margin amplifies losses. Consider reducing exposure.
Consider adding to MUU. Scanner shows an ACCUMULATE setup at 37.06-37.03 with a stop at 36.96.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Focus on risk management given your leveraged positions and market uncertainty.
